Five minutes of searching, or another excuse?

Kevin explains that you can learn almost anything on YouTube today. It may not be perfect information, but it is enough to get you started.

He has no patience for "I don't know how" when a few minutes of searching would answer it. Spend five minutes, he says, and there it is. Put it off because it might take three hours, and you become an expert at excuses.

What have you been putting off that five minutes could start?
